trajectories.label: First sit, right out of high school
trajectories.stratum_label: Tamil · cannot afford private · non-metro · no paid prep
trajectories.psych_burden: One high-stakes exam year while finishing Class XII — acute stress, but not yet multi-year identity foreclosure around the exam.
trajectories.delayed_life_note: Life start not yet delayed beyond a normal school-leaving year.
trajectories.punch_line: You paid almost nothing to sit right out of high school (cash outlay mid ≈ ₹0.2L). Your chance of an accessible MBBS seat your family can cash is 1.4% — not a rounding error of 0.01%, and still a brutal lottery.
caveats: Accessible seat ≠ qualify; private offer you cannot pay does not count.
CMSE is school tutoring, not NEET residential coaching.
Rate is synthetic-stratum model output, not a published individual probability.

trajectories.label: Two drop years, still cannot afford private
trajectories.stratum_label: Tamil · cannot afford private · non-metro · modest prep
trajectories.psych_burden: Two years of full-time prep identity: higher distress among repeat aspirants is documented in convenience samples (e.g. Alagappa / district surveys). Not an individual clinical risk score.
trajectories.delayed_life_note: Two years of delayed college/work entry; peers may already be earning or enrolled.
trajectories.punch_line: After ~2 years of studying, failed attempts, tutoring/lodging, and family opportunity cost (economic mid ≈ ₹9.7L; high coaching path ≈ ₹17.7L), your chance of an accessible seat your family can afford is still only 1.9% — a thin upgrade bought with years and money.
sources: Rajan Committee: ₹10L exclusive repeater coaching; long-term fee bands; avg ₹95,033
CMSE 2025 class_xii p90 as school-tutoring floor
PLFS 2025 no_college monthly median × 24 months opportunity cost
caveats: Rajan ₹10L is a TN narrative high for exclusive coaching — not a national mean.
Opportunity cost uses no_college wage median as a transparent counterfactual.
Modest prep does not unlock private seats the family still cannot pay.

trajectories.label: Two drop years, English + intensive + can pay private
trajectories.stratum_label: English · can afford private · metro · intensive prep
trajectories.psych_burden: Same calendar years and exam stress — with a family that can keep buying prep and cash a private offer if the rank allows.
trajectories.delayed_life_note: Same two-year delay; different ability to monetize a private allotment.
trajectories.punch_line: Same two-year ticket price in calendar time (economic mid ≈ ₹13.7L), but privilege raises accessible-seat chance to 7.9% — still a minority outcome, now with a privatized safety net.
sources: PLFS 2025 no_college monthly median opportunity-cost proxy
caveats: Contrast is compositional / scenario, not a causal LATE of coaching.
Can-pay private converts more score ranks into cashable seats.

warnings: Do not quote 0.01% unless a stratum model actually produces it; use published p_accessible.
TN admitted current-year share is not national birth-year microdata.
Costs are scenario bands with cited anchors, not causal treatment effects.
